description: This file defines two Flutter widget classes, Skeleton and CircleSkeleton, used for displaying placeholder skeletons in a UI.

classes.name: Skeleton
classes.description: A widget displaying a rectangular skeleton placeholder, configurable height, width, layer intensity, and corner radius.

classes.name: CircleSkeleton
classes.description: A widget displaying a circular skeleton placeholder with customizable size.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget's visual representation for both Skeleton and CircleSkeleton classes.
